about_the_game:
Survive the Swarm

Face relentless waves of aliens and rogue drones in this demo version of our 2.5D twin-stick shooter. Test your reflexes, your aim, and your nerves as enemies close in from every direction.

Retro Psychedelia

Step into a world where neon lights and distorted geometry collide. The demo showcases a slice of our trippy retro aesthetic — from pulsing color palettes to chaotic particle effects that bend perception.

Move and Shoot

Run, jump, and fire with full freedom of motion. Dual-stick controls let you shoot in any direction while dodging and weaving through danger.

Escalating Chaos

Each wave in the demo ramps up the intensity. Enemies hit harder, patterns get faster, and surviving just one more round becomes a desperate fight.

Demo Content

The demo includes three full levels, each serving as an arena where you’ll battle through escalating waves of enemies. It also features one playable character, giving you a taste of the full roster and playstyles planned for release.

Face the Horror (Preview)

The demo ends with a glimpse of the cosmic terror that awaits in the full game. A brief encounter with something vast, ancient, and impossibly wrong.

What’s Next

The full game will feature four playable characters, each with their own set of three arenas, culminating in a final level where all paths converge and the ultimate choice awaits.
